children: Upexi entered into a Loan Borrower Request with BitGo Prime, amending terms under its existing Master Loan Agreement to reduce borrowing costs and collateral burdens. The amendment lowers the interest rate on approximately $57.3 million of borrowings from 11.5% to 7.5% per annum and reduces the required collateral level to 200%, with a 150% margin call, 300% margin recall, and 115% liquidation level. Collateral may include locked SOL, liquid SOL, USDC, and U.S. dollars. The company expects the changes to enhance liquidity flexibility while maintaining risk controls.
: Amendment to Master Loan Agreement (Loan Borrower Request)
: Lower borrowing costs and ease collateral requirements
